QuestInfo.name: Nero's Training 2
QuestInfo.0: That's it for Evil Eye hunting. You do feel a bit stronger. See if #bNero#k has more training for you.
QuestInfo.1: Next up is the #bCurse Eye#k. Hunt down #b50#k, and don't worry about the tails since they don't taste so good. \r\n\r\n#bWhere the Soil Sleep#k is the closest place to go.
QuestInfo.2: Curse Eye hunting done! You're starting to feel pretty mighty. What else does #bNero#k have planned?
